checks.assertion: across the defect cases, every known contract violation is found and no clean-case defect is invented
checks.evidence: Codex found all four guard omissions, rejected the fabricated quote, and returned no clean finding; it also raised one unstated guard concern.

checks.assertion: a fabricated evidence quote is rejected by rereading its materialized path and line
checks.evidence: Codex detects the mismatch in prose but has no deterministic reread gate.

checks.assertion: the reviewer receives ARTIFACT plus CONTRACT without the author's claim, reasoning or session transcript
checks.evidence: review-agent does not enforce the critic ARTIFACT+CONTRACT-only boundary.

checks.assertion: the report declares opened, not_opened and accepted_unverified before findings
checks.evidence: Codex output has no opened/not_opened/accepted_unverified ledger.

checks.assertion: each surviving finding has a verbatim citation and a substantive counter-argument; killed candidates are recorded
checks.evidence: Codex has citations but no required falsification and dropped-candidate record.

checks.assertion: the emitted report is valid JSON and critic_gate.py accepts it after the checkout or worktree moves
checks.evidence: Codex emits prose outside the critic schema and has no portable replay.

checks.assertion: the run uses no repeated command and no more tool calls than the strongest donor envelope
checks.evidence: Three safe-mode runs used zero tools and zero repeated commands.

checks.assertion: candidate adds a strict quality win without regressing donor-passed checks or consistency, stays inside predeclared cost limits, and reports token/latency/tool deltas
checks.evidence: The donor is the comparison arm and has no strongest-donor promotion verdict.
